beats.text: 🌙 The night shift is out: Hushpuppy and Highbeam Deer. They own the dark — the cast turns over after sunset, and every step is riskier. A lit fire is a beacon — light through canvas, smoke on the wind. Sealed and dark, you're just a smell in the night. Haven's walls end every argument.
"Stonebridge has its own mouths," says Tariq. "We're sorry. Truly." (Refused — the ask didn't carry.)
◈ Cheryl begs the System to carry a call against the lingering The Cancellation — the relay is enthusiastic and already translating. A favor will be owed. That's the price of being carried.
🌙 Night. The lingering The Cancellation gorges at the treeline — 570 kcal gone from the stores. Drive it off, or call for help.
🥁 Darius Haddad of Emberhold walks in with 4 — Darius Haddad. "We're here. Where's the teeth?" (They showed up. Trust remembers.)
